Stable-реліз PITUSHNYA MCC версії 1.1.21.

Release v1.1.21

- Added square icon badges to the Home, Settings, and Info tabs.
- Updated the Screenshots action to use a camera icon and the donation action to use a coffee icon.
- Updated the combined log filter to use a list icon.
- Added the latest manifest version, latest release notes, and last-check result to the update settings panel.
- Manual and automatic update checks now refresh the visible update information immediately.
- Hardened fullscreen restore after taskbar, tray, and in-app minimize with explicit window-state recovery and a watchdog check.


Цей реліз використовує фіксований tag pitushnya для updater-каналу. Версію updater визначає через version.json.
